judgement.reason: Homepage is a stateless-capable Next.js dashboard whose YAML config can be baked into the image, so DEPLOYABLE_WITH_CHANGES is appropriate.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported storage: the app declares durable local state (HOMEPAGE_CONFIG_DIR (runtime source)) with no VOLUME or Compose mount. Deployz provides object storage, not an attached data directory.
reviews.reason: No shown line points HOMEPAGE_CONFIG_DIR at a supported datastore, and the Dockerfile only creates a local config directory, so whether the app needs durable local configuration stays open for the vendor to confirm.
